items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's mention of Lefty Arm, Lukey Sciro, or the band, indicating no personal connection or knowledge is demonstrated in the transcript.

ctx.x: Angelo Sciro. Angelo Sciro. Angelo Sciro. Angelo Sciro. And clarinet. He used to play clarinet a lot. Angelo Sciro.

I wonder if he's related to Lukey Sciro. I forgot to ask Lukey. You know Lukey? Lukey plays in Buck Banville for years. Lefty Arm and they were all in a band. You don't know Lukey? He's younger. When you started on drums, is that your first instrument, was it, I understand?
Did you have a teacher, just pick it up yourself?
